messages:
Maria: Quick kickoff — we need a short spec for SDK/Console error messaging when requests hit rate limits (429s). Product wants the SDK message to be actionable (retry info, what quota was hit, link to console docs), but we also need to avoid leaking internal IDs. Thoughts?

Liam: +1 actionable. Important: don't expose internal tenant IDs or exact thresholds. Fields I'd be comfortable with: `retry_after` (seconds), `scope` (enum: \"key\"|\"org\"|\"global\"), and a `docs` link. Keep body small. Consider returning an opaque `X-Quota-Hit` header for support correlation :+1:

Maria: Draft error body (proposal):
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "error": "rate_limit_exceeded",
  "retry_after": 12,
  "scope": "org",
  "quota": "standard-burst",
  "docs": "https://console.redwood.ai/docs/rate-limits#standard-burst",
  "support_contact": "https://console.redwood.ai/support?hit=opaque123"
}
```
Headers: `X-Request-Id: 000...`, `X-Quota-Hit: opaque123`

Liam: Prefer the header approach for the opaque id instead of query params in the docs link. Also, `quota` string is fine but don't expose numeric thresholds. For SDKs, recommend clients surface a localized friendly message and expose `retry_after` in SDK exceptions.

Sasha: From product/console POV — happy with an opaque hit id that opens the usage panel. Example deep link we can generate in Console: `https://console.redwood.ai/org/ACME/usage?limits=standard-burst&hit=opaque123` -> opens modal with suggested actions (wait, request increase, view historical spikes). I'll add a small banner copy: "You're currently hitting your standard burst limit — try lowering concurrency or request a temporary increase." :memo:

Noah: Operational concerns:
- We must log the quota hit server-side with hashed tenant id + hit id so Support can lookup without exposing PII.
- For Dedicated customers, we may want to include more granular info if their contract allows. Keep hosted defaults conservative.
- Also include `X-Req-Id` and `X-Quota-Hit` headers for correlation in observability.

Maria: Proposal summary:
- Error body: `error`, `retry_after`, `scope`, `docs`, `support_contact` (opaque link)
- Response headers: `X-Request-Id`, `X-Quota-Hit`
- No numeric thresholds in responses
- SDK guidance: surface user-friendly message + expose machine fields for programmatic backoff
- Console deep link uses `hit` param (opaque) to show modal with actions

Liam: SDK backoff snippet suggestion (pseudo):
```
let retryAfter = resp.retry_after || resp.headers['retry-after'] || 1
await wait(exponentialBackoff(retryAfter))
// surface a user-facing toast: "Rate limit reached — retrying in Xs"
```
Note: recommend SDKs implement jittered exponential backoff and cap after N retries.

Sasha: I'll own the console UX ticket and docs copy. Can someone from eng-sre make the server commit to returning `X-Quota-Hit` and wiring opaque ids to logs? I'll file a small PR for copy once we agree on wording.

Noah: I'll add the header and logging. One ask: add a telemetry field `quota_hit_type` to events (burst|sustained) so we can tune recommendations later.

Maria: Great. Action items:
- @Noah to add header + logging (SLA: EOD Thu)
- @Liam to update SDK error handling docs and add sample backoff (SLA: next Tue)
- @Sasha to create console ticket + copy (SLA: Fri)
- @Maria to write short RFC for API error shape (will paste PR link here)

ratebot: deploy scheduled: rate-limit-service v2 -> prod in 3h :rocket:

Liam: :thumbsup: catching the deploy, will coordinate if MTTR spikes.

Sasha: Thanks all — keeping copy minimal and action-oriented. Will loop back with drafts.

Maria: Filing RFC now, will post PR link here when ready.
